assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and near-syncope that are poorly correlated with standard short-term monitoring, raising concern for intermittent bradyarrhythmias associated with sick sinus syndrome.
The patient has a history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmia.
The need to capture infrequent symptomatic events over an extended period.
The long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring study (CPT 93247) is indicated to establish a definitive diagnosis and guide further management.
The diagnosis codes are I49.5 and I49.9.
The denial is under Reason Code PR-204.
This service directly addresses the intermittent symptomatic arrhythmias not detectable on short-term monitoring.
